patent.title: 一种助产用凝胶及其制备方法
assignees: 成都英诺新科技有限公司
patent.family_note: Holdout E3-A; divisional of ZL201410013147.4. NHSA materials also list sibling method/assay patents—do not conflate.

knowledge_origin.description: Public holdout E3-A; origin track beyond MAH inventorship not reconstructed.

technology.problem: 人阴道分娩中产道摩擦力与驻留导致产程延长与软组织损伤风险。
technology.mechanism: 助产凝胶：拉丝粘液+凝胶骨架+海藻酸钙微球等，降低动静摩擦转换（说明书/权利要求教导）。
technology.comparison_baseline: Prior midwifery lubricants cited in patent background; not independently re-benchmarked.

value_carriers.name: 诺欣顺® 卡波姆产道凝胶（0.5%，11ml:55mg）
value_carriers.description: MAH=assignee. NHSA NRDL filing/PPT explicitly names ZL201710337622.7 as composition IP for this drug. Claims check: granted claim 1 is a midwifery gel product+process; carrier is the same MAH's midwifery carbomer gel—plausible coverage. Independent full-formula match to claim ratios/microspheres not publicly available → strong_evidence not confirmed.

gaps.description: No public E4 attributing revenue/clinical benefit specifically to ZL201710337622.7 vs sibling patents or the drug as a whole.
Claim 1 is narrow (exact ratios + alginate microsphere process). Public label/NRDL materials do not publish a full formula enabling independent claim-chart confirmation.
needed_evidence: Full qualitative/quantitative formula under claim elements
Process disclosure matching claim 1 microsphere steps

notes: Holdout E3-A. T0=2026-10-13. Claims check: PASS (plausible MAH midwifery-gel claim ↔ 诺欣顺). E3=strong_evidence → R3 Implemented; NO auto R4/R5 (no E4). Sibling ZLs not used as this-case E3. Formal V0.7/schema 1.0; not V0.8.
